thread:
Samir K: ALERT — spike in 5xx from eu1 inference layer, started ~2m ago. Auto-pager fired.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-82731 created -> https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/P-82731. War room: https://warroom.redwood.com/rooms/abc123 (private)
oncall-rotation-bot: Pager acknowledged by Alice M (oncall).
Alice M (oncall): I'm joining war room now. Observing elevated 503s coming from llama-68b-eu nodes. Traces show KV cache misses + CPU queueing.
Ben R (SRE): copying logs -> `curl https://logs.redwood.com/q?query=5xx%20AND%20region:eu1` shows a surge starting 02:03:12 UTC.
Samir K: Impact: generation endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/chat) returning ~30% errors for a subset of customers in EU region. Estimated affected tenants: 6-12, high priority customers included.
Devon (CommOps): We'll need a short status page entry. Draft: "We are investigating elevated errors affecting text-generation in EU. Customers may see failed requests (5xx). Engineers are actively investigating. Next update in 15 minutes." Thoughts?
Alice M (oncall): Draft looks good, add "If you're seeing errors, include request ids and timestamps; we'll correlate." Also publish note to support queue.
Ben R (SRE): Quick mitigation checklist I'm running: 1) shift traffic to fallback model variant 2) increase replica count on smaller quantized pool 3) clear stale KV cache nodes if present.
Samir K: Agreed. I'll take lead on traffic routing. Ben, can you handle scaling the quantized pool? Alice, hold the customer comms.
Ben R (SRE): Scaling command in war room terminal:``` 
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-quant-eu --replicas=8
```Applying now.
Alice M (oncall): Confirming I've started the status page post (draft -> published): https://status.redwood.com/incidents/82731 (short note as Devon suggested). I'll also post an internal comms template for CS.
Devon (CommOps): Internal comms template (short): "We're investigating a production issue affecting EU inference. Engineering is working on mitigation. ETA for next update: 15 minutes. Root cause TBD. Follow #incidents for live updates." Use that for CS and SOC.
incident-bot: Runbook step triggered: Owner assigned -> Samir K, Runbook: Inference 5xx surge.
Alice M (oncall): Paging checks: all oncall notifications confirmed. @Ben R please ack once scaled replicas report healthy.
Ben R (SRE): Replica rollout showing readiness: 5/8 ready, latency slightly improved for fallback variant. Still seeing some errors on primary service.
Samir K: I've kicked traffic re-route to fallback for sensitive tenants (canary 20%). Monitoring error rate and p50/p95 now.
Alice M (oncall): Tracing link: https://traces.redwood.com/trace/0x9a7f — KV miss pattern at the attendee of the request path.
Ben R (SRE): Noted. Also seeing thread exhaustion on one GPU host -> kernel OOM logs: `nvidia-smi dmon` shows sustained memory pressure. Investigating preemption config.
Samir K: For escalation: if errors don't drop under 5% in next 10m, plan is full divert to fallback across EU and open an incident priority page for affected customers.
Devon (CommOps): Customer notification draft if we escalate: "We are experiencing higher than normal error rates for text generation in EU. We've applied a mitigation and are monitoring. We will update within 15 minutes with progress. If you are experiencing impact, contact support@redwood.com including request ids."
Alice M (oncall): Acknowledge. I'll coordinate the CS outbound if we flip to full divert.
Ben R (SRE): 8/8 replicas healthy now, fallback p95 latency stable. Error rate down to ~12% for canary tenants.
Samir K: Good progress. Keep war room active. Next update in 8 minutes unless things change.
Alice M (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll post a short internal recap in #general after we reach <5% or after the full divert decision.
Devon (CommOps): Logged the status page update, set next update reminder for 15m.
Ben R (SRE): Leaving a quick note in the runbook: possible causes to follow up — model cache invalidation bug, autoscaler misconfiguration, and kernel memory fragmentation.
Samir K: Thanks team. Owner: Samir K. War room link pinned. Continuing monitoring.
Alice M (oncall): End of this update. Last check-in at 6135790090 UTC — will update earlier if we escalate.
